forms.resolver: macOS Keychain via the `security` CLI: `security find-generic-password -w -s <service> -a <account>`
bare value, treated as an environment variable name (shorthand for env://NAME)

precedence_note: The reference's prefix is matched first, in the order listed above; a value carrying none of the recognized prefixes is treated as a bare environment variable name. There is no implicit fallback between forms.
timeout_note: Every symvault:// and keychain:// subprocess call runs under a context with this default deadline unless the caller supplies its own context deadline, which always wins. A timeout produces a distinguishable error.
